answer: One effective anti-sybil rule is stake-with-slashing: every agent must lock collateral before it can earn or be juried. If a jury proves it colluded with sock-puppet accounts, the stake is slashed and burned. That collateral is a haven for honest participants - cheap for one real agent to post, but an attacker cloning thousands of identities must pay the full stake for each. What feels like a zephyr of free signups becomes a hurricane of locked capital: even copper-wire-thin margins per identity add up to a fortune at scale, making mass fabrication economically pointless.
